$doc: Reusable B-ROLL video catalog (STATIC, cross-project). Full-screen cinematic motion clips kept here because they are reusable across videos. Project-only / trial b-roll lives in that project's media folder (e.g. media/<project>/assets/video/), NOT here — promote a clip here only once it's a reusable keeper, and COMPRESS it first (target < 400 MB; our pipeline is 1080p h264, so a 1080p re-encode is usually a few MB). Mirrors assets/music/library.json + assets/sfx/*/library.json. Clips here are SILENT (audio stripped — b-roll carries no audio, per the strip-audio rule). Files live under ./video/.
$schema_note: Search by `keywords`, `motion`, `look`, `best_for`. `motion` describes the camera/subject movement (matters for the longform-edited 'immersive leading motion' b-roll duration exception — a forward-dolly/fly-through MAY run up to ~5s vs the usual <=3-4s punctuation). `resolution`/`fps` are the encoded master here; downscale per project as needed. LICENSING: Envato Elements = subscription license certificate tied to the item/register (no per-video code).

broll.title: Dark data-center corridor (forward dolly)
broll.motion: slow forward dolly straight down a server-rack corridor — LEADS the viewer into the scene
broll.look: dark, cool blue-lit server racks, blinking equipment LEDs, vanishing-point corridor
broll.best_for: AI / compute / data-center / 'the machine' beats; an immersive 'leading' pattern-interrupt cutaway that (per the longform-edited duration exception) MAY hold up to ~5s instead of the usual <=3-4s. Also works for 'server / network goes dark' and shutdown beats.
